subject: settings.spec Assistant pill: fixed in c5cce1c; the cause is a feature_flags row saved before S14
body:
On a fresh stack at ebe45b2, settings.spec 'every group renders' passes (chromium-laptop-1440, webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-phone-390). The /settings/assistant route, the group and the spec entry are all on shared.

The cause: config.spec and admin.spec save feature_flags and restore it afterwards. On a database created before S14 (assistant off), that restore sets admin_edited_at, so the seeder keeps assistant off through every reseed. The nav then hides Assistant correctly, and the spec, which expected it, fails.

c5cce1c: the spec now reads /api/me features and expects the Assistant pill exactly when the server has it on. That still checks the flag gating. Verified with the flag on (3 projects) and switched off in the DB (passes, no pill).

To get Assistant back in a local DB like that: re-seed with --force, or PUT feature_flags with assistant.enabled true.
